images.title: Session feedback and reported bugs
images.note: Questions 21–22. Fifteen responses reported for question 21; six complete comments visible.
images.questionText: 21. What was the most confusing or frustrating part of this session?
comments: The difference between progression points, campus standings, and competitive rating was not always obvious, and some next-step guidance felt easy to miss.
The main friction was finding the right area on the first attempt; once there, most battle interactions were straightforward.
The core flow was enjoyable once I got oriented, though a few labels and next steps could be clearer for first-time users.
The main challenge was learning where different systems lived at first; after exploring them, the flow became much easier to follow.
The app was straightforward for the main tasks. I was initially unsure about the difference between ratings and standings, but everything else was easy to navigate.
The core loop was engaging and the visuals made most actions easy to follow. I would have liked a little more guidance around trades and their outcomes.

images.title: Additional session feedback
images.note: Supplied continuation of the session feedback. Six complete comments visible; the question header and response count are not shown.
comments: The app felt polished and the main actions were easy to complete. The turn timer could use a slightly clearer visual cue during Live play.
The core experience was enjoyable and easy to follow. The trail sequence took a moment to understand, but it became clear after checking the event details.
I found the experience easy to use and the battle flow was intuitive. The rankings information took a moment to interpret, but the rest of the app felt consistent.
Most of the session was clear and responsive; the only minor confusion was distinguishing the different competitive modes at first.
The navigation was extremely confusing and it was often unclear whether an action had worked or what I was expected to do next.
Some labels felt inconsistent, and I had to explore a few screens before understanding how the different progression systems connect.

images.title: Reported bugs and their descriptions
images.note: Questions 22 and 22a. The bug chart repeats question 22; count it once. Five responses reported for 22a; three complete comments visible.
images.questionText: 22a. If you encountered a bug, briefly describe the steps and what happened.
comments: I was unsure whether some unclear state changes were intended behavior or a bug, especially when feedback after an action was limited.
Opening the battle screen and selecting an action sometimes left the interface unchanged, so I could not tell whether the action had registered.
A few actions appeared to do nothing on the first attempt, but I could not reproduce the behavior consistently.

images.title: Requested improvements and repeat use
images.note: Questions 23–24. Fifteen responses reported for question 23; eight complete comments visible.
images.questionText: 23. What single improvement should we prioritise next?
comments: Make the current objective and the result of each action more prominent, with clearer status labels and immediate feedback.
Make entry points to key areas more consistent and add clearer first-time guidance for navigation.
Improve onboarding and make the next recommended action more visible without adding too much extra text.
Keep the navigation labels and action feedback consistent, especially when moving between collection, battles, and rankings.
Clarify the difference between ratings and standings near the relevant screens.
Add a clearer summary of what each player gives and receives before confirming a trade.
Show the evolution requirements more prominently before a card is selected.
Make the Live turn timer more prominent, especially when it is close to running out.
